description.zh:
密钥ID或密钥资源名称（ARN）。
>访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`。
description.en:
The ID or Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the key.

> When you access a key in another Alibaba Cloud account, you must enter the ARN of the key. The ARN of a key is in the `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}` format.

description.zh: 密钥策略名称。仅支持固定值default。
description.en: The name of the key policy. Only the static value default is supported.

descriptions.zh:
- RAM用户或RAM角色调用该OpenAPI需要被授予的权限策略详情，请参见[访问控制](~~2767210~~)。

- 由于密钥策略名称仅支持设置为default，因此查询时密钥策略名称（PolicyName）仅支持输入default，否则会提示`Not Found`。
descriptions.en:
- For more information about the access policy required for a Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role to call this operation, see [Resource Access Management](~~2767210~~).

- Because the key policy name can only be set to default, you must set the PolicyName parameter to default when you query the key policy. Otherwise, a `Not Found` error is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms get-key-policy --key-id key-hzz630494463ejqjx0000 --policy-name default --region cn-hangzhou
